claims.statement: Process HTTP liveness, readiness and health are LifecycleTracker observations distinct from workload freshness; starting can be live but unready, and degraded health can return HTTP 200.

Management GetHealth returns unknown because authoritative process health telemetry is not registered, while management status describes topology and leases with observation/source provenance rather than a cross-store transactional snapshot.
CLI query and shell use live TCP PGWire rather than direct gateway handler calls, separate from the management RPC and process HTTP paths.

The operator observation model routes seven questions through health/status/view status/doctor, catalog node/view/resource/shard/operation tables and worker memory metrics, comparing input and published progress and freshness SLO rather than liveness alone.

SHOW WORKLOAD APPLICATION separates requested policy from actual gateway-local quota accounting and explicitly cannot attest remote worker enforcement: assigned workloads report NULL worker effective revision and worker_ack_unavailable.

View degradation reasons distinguish source waiting, quota rejection, spilling, checkpoint alignment, sink blocking, topology transition and recovery, with maximum lag contribution and deterministic tie ordering for the dominant contributor.

Pipeline stall localization groups recorded operator frontiers by view, flags minimum source frontiers and flags minimum operator frontiers only when below the maximum; lag_behind_max_ms is epoch difference times 1000.
Operator frontier telemetry is held in a bounded process-local registry that clears on new-key overflow, so a missing or equal-frontier stall report is not proof of advancing durable progress.
The exchange backpressure Prometheus gauge reports a ratio from zero to one, providing capacity evidence to correlate with workload memory, spill and downstream symptoms.
The control shard manager owns fenced shard leases with monotonically increasing tokens that prevent stale writers committing after reassignment; stale-token errors are RS-1702.

Doctor produces non-destructive PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP reports, defaults to a five-second per-check timeout and clamps per-check timeouts to 30 seconds; that clamp is not a whole-run timeout because checks are awaited sequentially.

Shared runtime diagnostics preserve codes, correlation IDs, context, retry hints and catalog next steps while redacting and bounding context to 32 entries/8 KiB and the recent process-local occurrence journal to 256 entries with eviction counters.
Management drain, migration and backup requests persist Pending intent and idempotency binding before asynchronous dispatch; records expose phase, status, timestamps, progress, errors and next steps.

Management idempotency exact retries return the same record, changed requests under a key conflict, and expired keys fail precondition; keys last 24 hours and create-only transitions keyed by previous record hash prevent concurrent advancement.
Pending, Running and Waiting are nonterminal management outcomes, not completion; Succeeded, Failed and Cancelled are immutable terminal outcomes retained for seven days.
Management restart converts Running records to Waiting while preserving phase/progress, reconciles pending/waiting stored requests and scans nonterminal operations every second.

Management cancellation is limited to pending or named pre-lease-transfer phases, rejects later cancellation without changing the record, and cancelled donor handoff requires acknowledgement and reopening under the unchanged lease.

Migration requires different healthy active workers sharing a shard store, validates unchanged fenced ownership, waits for donor flush/close before lease transfer and recipient open before success, and performs rollback handling on recipient-open failure.

Current management migration and drain reject registered active workload deployments; drain waits for worker flush and matching recipient-open acknowledgements rather than treating dispatch as success.

The management endpoint has no TLS or server-side authorization and CLI identity flags do not authenticate remote callers; capabilities reflect attached executors and CLI management status errors collapse to RS-0003.

Explicit --management sends admin backup create to asynchronous CreateBackup; the legacy local manifest format consumed by admin backup inspect/verify is separate from committed management checkpoint generations.

Management backup requires idle workloads/source writes and an attached authoritative shard store shared by all owners; it collects durable shard checkpoints, excludes operational logs and live topology, validates terminal commit before success and distinguishes temporary waiting from integrity failure.

Checkpoint exports must represent committed checkpoint-pinned data rather than copying a live mutable object prefix, and the DR runbook requires separate recovery storage and reported checkpoint/object/byte/SUCCESS verification.

Checkpoint generation validation checks terminal marker, generation and checkpoint consistency, shard epochs, per-object length/SHA-256 and inventory digest/byte totals without requiring the source control plane.

Restore validates before staging, verifies staged data and publishes the active-generation bootstrap pointer after reconstruction; a different active generation is rejected while matching generation/checkpoint permits idempotent success.

DR recovery requires fresh offline target storage, leaves RS-3614 failures offline, and validates complete sorted view rows plus checkpoint/catalog/topology/leases and connector resume state after startup; measured drill RPO/RTO are not general guarantees.
The upgrade runbook prescribes control quorum-preserving rolling upgrades before worker graceful drains and gateway connection drains.

Rolling-upgrade qualification is a narrower immutable-image three-worker abrupt replacement scenario comparing complete view/sink effects, source checkpoints and fenced leases; its injected pre-registration failure is retried forward and it does not qualify downgrade, graceful drain, control/gateway upgrades, multiple active shards or zero downtime.

PGWire stall diagnostic tests cover slow-source and wedged-operator localization, missing-view errors with actionable next steps, and Prometheus frontier metrics, rather than end-to-end recovery correctness.
SRE support artifacts distinguish automatic startup JSON from on-demand support bundles and are diagnostic evidence rather than checkpoint backups.
